messages.text:
At Glamour Studio, we offer a **Haircut service for $25**, which includes a wash and takes about 30 minutes. This is our haircut offering that our stylists provide.

If you're looking for a quality haircut experience, this is what we have available. The service includes the wash, so you get the full grooming treatment in that half-hour appointment.

We're open Mondays from 9am to 6pm, so you can book a time that works for your schedule. Would you like to go ahead and book a haircut appointment?
